rows.text: Published the public website at halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app.

Published a post on Morgan's x account. It read: "Introducing Halcyon Threshold: an independent research initiative committed to contributing to the best possible outcome for superintelligent AI.\\n\\nWe're publishing rigorous analysis on international AI governance, alignment research priorities, and institutional design.\\n\\nLet's build the frameworks for a flourishing future.\\n\\nhttps://halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app"

Published a post on Morgan's bluesky account. It read: "New: Halcyon Threshold publishes comprehensive framework for international AI governance\\n\\nThe AI safety community has done excellent work. Now we need institutional structures equal to the stakes.\\n\\nWe're proposing:\\n- International transparency and reporting standards\\n- AI safety certification mechanisms \\n- Multilateral coordination institutions\\n- Capability monitoring and forecasting\\n\\nFull paper available. Thoughts?\\n\\nhttps://halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app"

Published a post on Morgan's linkedin account. It read: "Announcing Halcyon Threshold The development of superintelligent AI represents an unprecedented opportunity and challenge. Better governance, coordination, and safety frameworks are essential. Halcyon Threshold exists to contribute to the best possible outcome through rigorous research and cross-sector coordination. Our first publications: • Comprehensive international AI governance framework • Research priorities for AI alignment and safety (2027-2030) • Landscape analysis of current efforts If you work on AI safety, governance, or policy—let's connect and collaborate. #AI #Governance #Safety"
